name: Committing Suicide
overview: Scripture clearly teaches the sanctity of life, as seen in the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13), which applies to all human life, including one's own. The Proverbs highlight the destructive nature of sin and cruelty toward oneself, warning that those who hate God love death and harm their own souls (Proverbs 8:36; 11:17). Ecclesiastes cautions against foolishness that leads to premature death, underscoring that life is to be preserved within God's appointed time (Ecclesiastes 7:17). Ultimately, through faith in Christ, believers pass from death into eternal life, assured that nothing, not even death, can separate them from God's love (John 5:24; Romans 8:38).
